text:
erin_sales: Kicking off HorizonTrust POC thread. They want Okta SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning for ~50k users initial import, RBAC via group mapping, domain proofing for tenant isolation, and a 2-week Dedicated burst for load validation. Need ops, security, and pricing notes.

devin_se: Quick clarifier: will Horizon push groups or do SCIM group sync? Also ask whether they want JIT on SAML login or authoritative provisioning only.

sam_horizon: We prefer authoritative provisioning. We can provide an initial export. We currently use Okta Group Push for some apps but want SCIM for Redwood. No JIT.

devin_se: Recommended POC flow: 1) one-time bulk ingest via SFTP/validated CSV (we support S3 or SFTP drop with checksum) to avoid 50k immediate SCIM calls; 2) scoped SCIM token for delta sync (paged results supported); 3) JSON group->role mapping for RBAC.

devin_se: Example mapping (API payload): {"okta_group":"ht_engineers","redwood_role":"engineer"}

maria_security: Security questionnaire items: 1) SAML encrypted assertions? We support encrypted assertions (RSA-OAEP + AES-GCM) when SP metadata includes encryption KeyDescriptor. 2) SCIM transport: hosted = TLS + bearer token; Dedicated/Private = option for mTLS. 3) Audit logs retention: hosted default 90d; enterprise add-on or Dedicated can be 12 months. 4) KMS/CMEK: Hosted supports cloud CMK for Dedicated; Private supports HSM/FIPS where required.

sam_horizon: Procurement insists on mTLS for provisioning and 12mo retention. They also want proof of data residency (EU) and a redacted penetration test report.

maria_security: mTLS requires Dedicated or Private. We can do a pro-rated Dedicated burst with mTLS enabled. We have EU Dedicated regions. Pen test + SOC2 artifacts can be attached after legal approval. Also note: Horizon asked about SAML logout and session idle timeout control (30m). We support session configuration and forced SSO logout through IdP-initiated logout.

devin_se: Operational notes: - For bulk import we validate CSV schema (email, fullname, external_id, groups[]). - We can accept SFTP drop or presigned S3 PUT + checksum; SFTP option requested by a few banks. - SCIM pagination and bulk patch endpoints supported (max 500 per call). - If they need group->role sync from Okta Group Push, we can map group names or use SAML roles attribute as fallback.

infra-bot: [infra-bot] Presigned SFTP endpoint created: sftp.redwood.ai/horizon-poc (one-time creds will be shared).

erin_sales: Pricing ask: firm 2-week Dedicated burst quote (target 1.5k TPS peak for a 48h soak). Procurement needs a number for PO. Do we have hourly per-GPU or pro-rated daily?

devin_se: Finance prefers pro-rated minimum + hourly GPU rate + daily burst cap. I'll sketch a conservative mGPU count for 1.5k TPS and return numbers. Recommend include overage per-1k TPS.

maria_security: Note a potential blocker: if Horizon insists on mTLS + EU region + customer-managed KMS + HSM, Private might be required. We'll surface this in the commercial note.

sam_horizon: Also need domain proofing for inbound webhook validation and email-based tenant proofing. Can we do DNS TXT + signed token email verification?

devin_se: Yes: domain proofing options supported: DNS TXT verification, file-hosted token, or email-based verification for tenant email domains. For webhook inbound validation we also support signed webhook secrets and cert pinning for Dedicated.

security-bot: [security-bot] SAML SP metadata generator: https://console.redwood.ai/metadata/horizon-poc (expires in 7 days)

erin_sales: Action items: 1) Sam to provide SP metadata + initial CSV sample or confirm SFTP use; 2) Devin to draft POC ops doc (Okta setup steps, mapping JSON, SCIM endpoints, bulk CSV schema); 3) Maria to collate SOC2/pentest links and confirm EU region/KMS options; 4) Finance to return burst quote (48h). We'll reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:

sam_horizon: I'll upload SP metadata and share one-time SFTP creds by EOD. Also pushing procurement for a hosted exception but likely will accept Dedicated for mTLS.

maria_security: I'll prep a short commercial & security summary for procurement explaining options (hosted trial limitations, Dedicated/Private capabilities, data residency). Will include SLA note: Dedicated committed capacity SLA 99.9%; bursts are subject to capacity and may be best-effort unless contracted.

erin_sales: Closing loop for now. Flagging blocker: if procurement requires Private deployment for HSM we need lead time for infra. Otherwise Dedicated burst likely acceptable. Thanks team. :wave:
